thread:
maria: Hi all — new hire question from my first week. Who owns service responsibility docs, the various 'forms/configs' and the oncall handoff templates for the Alerts service? I need to update a field for a migration and don't want to edit the wrong place.

alex: Welcome! :wave: Ownership lives in the Ownership Matrix (internal doc). Quick answers: Alerts runtime/configs -> eng-platform; runbooks/oncall procedures -> eng-sre; handoff templates -> people-ops.

jonah: To find the exact files: https://redwood.internal/docs/ownership -> search for "Alerts". Repo-level configs are in `infra/alerts-config` and the runbooks are in the `runbooks/alerts` folder. If you need write access, open a ticket in #eng-infra or DM @platform-support.

maria: Thanks — what should the ticket say? Any template?

jonah: Short template works. In #eng-infra paste: 
```
Request: write access
Service: Alerts
Files: runbooks/alerts/* and infra/alerts-config/*
Reason: updating oncall handoff for migration
Urgency: low/medium
```
Also mention your manager for approval.

sasha: For the handoff template specifically, use the People Ops canonical template: https://drive.google.com/po-templates/oncall-handoff (fill the "transition checklist" section). Put the filled form in the runbook PR and ping the oncall owner to ACK. :white_check_mark:

maria: Got it — who do I ping for the ACK?

jonah: Current Alerts oncall rotation is in the rota service. Quick check (bot):

ops-oncall: Current Alerts oncall: alice -> bob -> carl. Next shift change: 2026-03-30 09:00 UTC. Pager channel: #eng-oncall-alerts.

jonah: Escalation path: pager -> oncall -> eng-sre lead -> eng manager. If SEV1, also @product-ops and @support-lead. For config changes that risk rollout, include a rollout plan and canary window.

maria: Perfect. One last thing — is there a place where teams list escalation contacts/phone numbers?

alex: Yes, add your name to the Ownership Matrix entry and the oncall rota once you get access. For urgent contact numbers we keep a secure KMS-backed sheet (ask security for access: `security-access@redwood.com`).

maria: Thanks everyone — I'll open the ticket now and follow the handoff template. Appreciate the quick answers! :pray:

alex: Ping me if the ticket stalls, I can approve the access.

jonah: FYI, command to request addition to oncall calendar once access granted: ```/oncall add @maria Alerts --start 2026-04-01```

maria: noted, thanks!
